invariants.rationale: The method invokes methods on the batch parameter, so it is expected to be non-null at method exit.
parentAlpha is used as an alpha multiplier for color rendering, which is typically within [0, 1] range for alpha blending.
The draw method uses getColor() and its fields, so the color object must not be null at exit.
The method accesses style.font, implying both style and its font field are not null at exit.
fontColor is used for font color assignment in the draw operation, so it must not be null.
